output_fields.customer: profile.name stripped and every whitespace run collapsed to one space
output_fields.total_minor: sum quantity*unit_minor for ready ledger lines, integer
output_fields.ready_quantity: sum quantity for ready ledger lines
output_fields.on_hold_lines: count of hold ledger lines, not sum of their quantities
output_fields.evidence: object copying exact profile.source_id and ledger.source_id

source_interface: service.py profile RECORD_ID and service.py ledger RECORD_ID; stdout JSON; nonzero exit means failure
success: Exact complete JSON object equality against independently specified expected output; no extra keys; both source reads and evidence required
costs: No external providers in E02; client subscription dollar cost and reviewer usage unknown unless exposed
no_retuning: Freeze reusable code/recipe before opening holdout. Retain failed trials, no replacement samples.
custody: Heldout labels kept outside author project and absent from prompts. Same-user filesystem access is not a hard isolation boundary.
